text: At 65 minutes, Redmond Rovers raise their defensive line higher on the pitch, pressing more aggressively to regain possession. They increase the speed and directness of their attacks, sending more forward passes into Ironvale Athletic’s defensive third on both flanks. While their overall possession drops, they tilt the field strongly toward Ironvale’s goal at the far end, creating more scoring chances within the penalty area. Their players apply tighter pressure across the midfield area to disrupt Ironvale’s build-up and force turnovers[#1190].
